questions.question: What are Indiana Jones and the Nazis racing to find in Raiders of the Lost Ark?
questions.note: The chest that held the Ten Commandments tablets. Opening it does not go well for the Nazis.

questions.question: Who directed Raiders of the Lost Ark?
questions.note: Lucas created Indy and produced. Spielberg directed the first four films.

questions.question: In Raiders, where does Indy find Marion Ravenwood when he needs the headpiece?
questions.note: The Raven. She still has her father’s piece of the Staff of Ra. She also punches Indy.

questions.question: What is the name of Indy’s rival French archaeologist in Raiders?
questions.note: René Belloq, played by Paul Freeman. He is waiting at the bottom of the opening temple, too.

questions.question: What is Indiana Jones famously afraid of?
questions.note: The Well of Souls is full of them. “Snakes. Why did it have to be snakes?”

questions.question: In what year was Raiders of the Lost Ark released?
questions.note: After Star Wars and The Empire Strikes Back, before Return of the Jedi.

questions.question: What does Indy grab in the opening temple before the giant boulder starts rolling?
questions.note: South America, Hovitos, a bag of sand that is not quite the right weight.

questions.question: In the Cairo marketplace, how does Indy deal with the show-off swordsman?
questions.note: Ford was sick and asked to skip the long fight. Spielberg kept the one-shot gag.

questions.question: What is Indiana Jones’s signature weapon?
questions.note: He also carries a revolver. The whip is the silhouette on the poster.

questions.question: In Raiders, what does Indy tell Marion about why he looks beat up?
questions.answer: It’s not the years, honey, it’s the mileage
choices: It’s not the years, honey, it’s the mileage
I’m making this up as I go
questions.note: In her bar in Nepal, after she punches him. Ford’s Indy in one sentence.
